park.name: Cold Harbor, Richmond National Battlefield Park

release.reason: Held until the owner walks both courses at Cold Harbor against the NPS trail map, including the four stretches on the tour road (Anderson Wright Drive) that join the trail pieces, and confirms with the park whether an organised run needs a special use permit.

road_connectors.20260277: Anderson Wright Drive by the visitor center, the park's tour road; 57 m joins the two ends of the Main Trail. The owner chose to join the trail pieces along the tour road rather than wait for OSM foot links (issue #1430, 2026-11-19).
road_connectors.20286996: Anderson Wright Drive, the park's one-way tour road; 219 m joins the Extended Loop Trail pieces east of the road. Owner decision, issue #1430, 2026-11-19.
road_connectors.320263962: Anderson Wright Drive, the park's one-way tour road; 159 m and 41 m join the Main Trail and the two Extended Loop Trail pieces west of the road. Owner decision, issue #1430, 2026-11-19.

race_courses.name: Cold Harbor, 5 km
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the Main Trail in the field east of the tour road, about 155 m from the tour-road crossing. Each lap goes round counterclockwise: the Main Trail south-west to the visitor center, the Main Trail back east, the Extended Loop Trail north, the Western Trail, and back down the tour road; the four short stretches on Anderson Wright Drive (the one-way tour road, run facing the traffic) join the trail pieces where OSM and the ground leave them apart.

route_guide.getting_there: Park at the Cold Harbor Visitor Center on Cold Harbor Road and walk out on the Main Trail. The start line is on the Main Trail in the open field east of the tour road, between the tour-road crossing and the Extended Loop Trail junction.
